The next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June. I told Marcus that in a thread on his #north-team message, but my first reply in that thread wrongly said 25 November.

- **What went wrong:** On 14 October Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team. Later that day she corrected it to 10 June in #north-random, saying she had read the wrong line. I answered Marcus from #north-team before I'd read #north-random.
- **The fix:** My second reply in the same thread tells Marcus to ignore the first one and use 10 June on the account sheet. Marcus is a member of #north-random, so passing on Ilse's correction only repeats something he could already see.
- **Unchecked:** There are no Brackenwater files in the share, so I couldn't confirm 10 June against a contract.
